run_qasc_main: run the QASC dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_qasc_dataset: create a QASC dataset instance that loads the Hugging Face qasc dataset for few-shot learning
review_get_choices_and_answer_string: review the QASC get_choices_and_answer_string method to extract answer choices and correct answer from a datapoint
review_map_hf_dataset_to_list: review the QASC map_hf_dataset_to_list method to convert a Hugging Face dataset split into question-answer tuples
summarize_load_dataset: summarize the QASC load_dataset method that loads the qasc dataset from Hugging Face
